text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Supreme commander of the Macedonian army Kiro Gligorov has raised combat readiness of the second corps at the border with Albania in the Ohrid, Kicevo, Tetovo, Debara and Gostivar barracks. Macedonian defence ministry claims almost all border posts on the Albanian side towards Macedonia and Yugoslavia captured by Albanian rebels.

- The ruling SDAM party submits declaration on the development of inter-ethnic relations that should be adopted at today's parliament session. Leaders of opposition parties VMRO-DPMNY and DP, Ljubco Georgievski and Petar Gosev, refused to participate in the session.
- According to latest auditing results, the bankrupt TAT savings bank was a classic case of money laundering. Behind the bank's former success stand leading figures from Macedonia's establishment.

- Students on hunger stike decided to withdraw from public life and refused to participate in the parliament session. They have called the citizens for massive support of their demands and threatened to demand resignation of the entire government.

- Macedonian foreign ministry could neither confirm nor deny any connections of the TAT bank with pyramidal saving banks in Albania. Also no confirmation on possible 40 bank deposits from Greece. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
